scope: Offline story companion and its repository-reference validation, not KNX application or hardware certification.
browser_scope: Keyboard navigation, focus, search, zoom and pan
Text view, persistence and no-JavaScript access
Live motion cancellation, OS reduced motion, finite growth and retreat
Hostile markup remains literal; no console/page/CSP errors

visual_review.limitation: The small guided mobile graph remains dense: some labels touch nodes/edges. Full text is available through event cards, text mode and searchable/zoomable atlas. This is not a claim of universal label legibility or screen-reader certification.

privacy_warnings_reviewed: Two historical semantic-version strings match the address-like pattern; neither is an installation address. No private locators or usage-limit remarks found in field-scoped review.
failed_attempts_retained: Initial queued browser worker cancelled before execution after conservative socket-budget preflight; corrected attempt uses maintained temp guard and real launch probe.
Initial tooling invocations used shadowed imports or missing worktree dependencies; corrected environment passed without source changes.
Isolated story invocation removed the required local import root; canonical documented invocation passed.
Overly greedy private review regex matched across unrelated JSON fields; field-scoped review resolved this reader false positive.
not_tested: Orca or other actual screen readers

publication.note: Only local preparation accepted. The owner must approve this exact digest before a publication push; old edition remains intact until authorized cutover.
